summary.en-US: A real-time countdown to the Android lock-down — and how to stop it

description.en-US:
Keep Android Open is a campaign app about Android Developer Verification, Google's plan to make every app register to a centrally verified developer before it can be installed on certified Android devices. Enforcement starts September 30, 2026 in Brazil, Indonesia, Singapore and Thailand, and expands globally in 2027.

The app:
* Counts down in real time to January 1, 2027, the date Android becomes a locked-down platform.
* Explains the rollout: what Developer Verification is, the timeline, your three paths (full distribution, limited distribution, or sideloading unregistered apps — ADB or the "advanced flow"). The advanced flow is not a solution: it lives in Google Play services, so Google can change or remove it at any time.
* Helps you act now: a pre-written letter you can email, copy or share to your government representatives, DOJ and FTC antitrust forms, and competition and consumer regulators across the world.

Open source (MIT), no ads, no tracking, no proprietary dependencies. Countdown target matches the banner at https://keepandroidopen.org.

This is an unofficial, non-commercial companion app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the official Keep Android Open campaign.

Disclosure: this app was developed with the assistance of generative AI; much of the source was written by an AI coding assistant.
